item.title: Penn State OL Vega Ioane Opts Out of Pinstripe Bowl
item.description: Penn State's depth continues to dwindle ahead of its bowl game. Starting left guard Vega Ioane opted out of the Pinstripe Bowl against Clemson and declared for the NFL draft, he announced on X on Friday. He joins defensive tackle Zane Durant and safety Zakee Wheatley as Nittany Lions who've officially opted out. item.title: State College Man Who Sexually Preyed on Autistic Toddlers Sentenced to Decades in Federal Prison
item.description: A State College man on Thursday received the maximum sentence for what federal prosecutors called sexually predatory behavior targeting autistic and nonverbal toddlers. William S. Welsh, 29, was sentenced to 30 years in prison after pleading guilty to one count of producing child pornography. U.S. District Judge Matthew Brann also ordered that Welsh serve 10 years of supervised release after his confinement and register as a sex offender. item.title: Juana’s Venezuelan Cuisine Closing, But Owner Plans to Return With New Format
item.description: A Venezuelan restaurant in downtown State College is closing, but its owner plans to relaunch in early 2026 with what she calls a new business concept. Juana's Venezuelan Cuisine, 129 S. Fraser St., will conclude its weeklong celebration of seven years in business at 7 p.m. Friday, owner and chef Ady Martinez announced in an Instagram post. item.title: Dead Canary: Alive and Well in Philipsburg
item.description: This story originally appeared in the December 2025 issue of Town&Gown magazine. item.title: Missing Hunter Found Dead in Penns Valley
item.description: A missing hunter was found dead on Saturday morning in Penns Valley after a search that began late Friday afternoon. Emergency response agencies were dispatched at about 4:30 p.m. Friday to the 400 block Green Grove Road in Gregg Township for a search detail. The Centre County coroner was called to the scene on Saturday morning, and just before noon the Gregg Township Fire Company in a Facebook post thanked the agencies that assisted with the search. item.title: Arboretum at Penn State Lights Up With ‘Winter’s Glow’
item.description: Winter’s Glow returned to The Arboretum at Penn State on Saturday evening, continuing a holiday tradition that began in 2014 as the Winter Celebration before evolving into its current annual format. item.title: Penn State Wrestling Dominates Wyoming 40-7
item.description: Penn State wrestling (4-0) won eight of 10 bouts, scoring bonus points in six, en route to a nonconference dual meet road victory at Wyoming on Saturday. Marcus Blaze, Shayne Van Ness, Mitchell Mesenbrink and PJ Duke each won by fall, while Luke Lilledahl and Levi Haines scored technical falls in the win.
